messages:
sara_marketing: Quick thread: launching a small pricing + webinar funnel experiment next week. Need final microcopy variants for the calc CTA, the webinar follow-up sequence, and routing rules for leads who pick 'Send detailed quote'. Drafts in the doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/pricing/microlaunch (pls comment).

dan_growth: Proposed CTAs for the calc result card: 1) 'Get a tailored quote' 2) 'See estimated plan' 3) 'Talk to sales'. Which maps best to conversion?

louise_cx: From CX perspective, option 1 feels high-intent and will increase demo requests; option 2 is lower friction for self-serve. I'd test 1 vs 2. Keep the language concise.

tom_sales: Routing: if user clicks 'Get a tailored quote' create a lead via /webhooks/lead_create with payload keys: email, estimate_usd, intent_source='calc', wants_quote=true. Example payload: `{"email":"x@org.com","estimate_usd":4200,"wants_quote":true}`. Also set `priority=high` when estimate_usd >= 5000.

neil_prod: We'll expose `wants_quote`, `estimate_usd`, `region` and `utm_experiment` in the webhook. Feature-flagging under `pricing_webinar_funnel`. ETA to wire: Tuesday morning.

sara_marketing: Good. Webinar follow-up sequence idea: immediate email (personalized estimate + invite to 30-min deep-dive), 3-day reminder with a short benchmark blurb, and a 2-week nurture with product comparisons. Can legal sign off on the benchmark wording?

dan_growth: For benchmark blurb in follow-up email: "In early internal tests, Redwood reduced per-token inference cost while matching latency profiles of baseline stacks." Keep it qualitative (no %s) until we lock metrics.

louise_cx: Add a short FAQ snippet to the follow-up: "How accurate is my estimate?" -> "Estimates are based on typical usage patterns; production pricing may vary depending on committed usage, quantization, and caching. Request a tailored quote for an exact figure." Link to /help/pricing-explainer.

tom_sales: Please include a lead field `interested_in_webinar_demo` so SDRs can prioritize follow-up. Also want `referral_path` derived from utm params.

neil_prod: We'll add `interested_in_webinar_demo` and `referral_path`. Suggested rollout: pilot to 5% traffic -> evaluate demo CTR and lead quality -> expand.

sara_marketing: Microcopy variants for email subject lines? Drafts: A) "Your Redwood estimate + invite" B) "See how much Redwood could save you" C) "Quick follow-up & tailored quote" Pick two to A/B.

dan_growth: I'd test A vs B. A feels personal; B is benefit-led. Primary metric: demo-book rate.

louise_cx: For EU audiences, include VAT phrasing and localized date formats in emails. Also ensure unsubscribe & data handling language matches regional regs.

sara_marketing: Noted. Neil, can you set the webhook to append `utm_experiment=pricing_webinar_v1` and variant label when payloads are emitted?

neil_prod: Yes, we'll add `utm_experiment` and `variant=A|B`. Also we'll tag events in GA via the reg form.

tom_sales: One more ask: when estimate_usd > 10000, set `enterprise_interest` true and auto-create an opportunity in Salesforce with source=pricing_calc.

neil_prod: We can add that mapping in the fanout logic. Will coordinate with Sales ops to confirm fields.

deploy-bot: Reminder: marketing experiment checklist due 2025-09-18 10:00 UTC. Checklist: https://release.redwood.ai/checklists/pricing-webinar-funnel

sara_marketing: Thanks all. Actions: Neil wires webhook + experiment tags (Tues AM), Dan prepares A/B email plan, Louise drafts localized FAQ snippets, Tom confirms SF mapping. I'll update the doc and ping if any blockers.
